# Viscosity — Thermalization

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “shear viscosity entropy ratio”).

claims.name: shear_viscosity_satisfies_universal_shearviscosity
claims.statement: The shear viscosity satisfies the universal shear-viscosity to entropy ratio in this holographic dual.

sources.title: The quark-gluon plasma and D6-branes on the conifold

claims.name: lowerdimensional_shear_viscosity_entropy_density
claims.statement: The lower-dimensional shear viscosity to entropy density ratio is temperature independent, and the bulk viscosity to shear viscosity ratio is $\frac{\bar\zeta}{\bar\eta}=\delta^{2}$.

sources.title: Higher-derivative scalar-vector-tensor theories: black holes, Galileons, singularity cloaking and holography

claims.name: shear_viscosity_entropy_density_ratio
claims.statement: The shear viscosity to entropy density ratio is explicitly computed.

sources.title: Causality of black holes in 4-dimensional Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet-Maxwell theory

claims.name: bulk_viscosity_vanishes_while_shearviscositytoentropy
claims.statement: The bulk viscosity vanishes, while the shear-viscosity-to-entropy ratio matches the relativistic case.

sources.title: Hyperscaling-Violating Lifshitz hydrodynamics from black-holes: Part II

claims.name: shear_viscosity_entropy_density_ratio_
claims.statement: The shear viscosity to entropy density ratio is universally $1/4\pi$.

sources.title: Holographic Charged Fluid with Anomalous Current at Finite Cutoff Surface in Einstein-Maxwell Gravity

claims.name: universality_contrasted_shear_viscosity_entropy
claims.statement: This universality is contrasted with the shear viscosity to entropy density ratio.

sources.title: Universality of second order transport in Gauss-Bonnet gravity

claims.name: shear_viscosity_entropy_density_ratio__
claims.statement: The shear viscosity to entropy density ratio is calculated for this solution.

sources.title: Einstein-Yang-Mills AdS Black Brane Solution in Massive Gravity and Viscosity Bound

claims.name: ratio_shear_viscosity_entropy_density
claims.statement: The ratio of shear viscosity to entropy density saturates the universal bound.

claims.name: lhcenergy_analyses_including_both_bulk
claims.statement: The LHC-energy analyses including both bulk and shear viscosity lead to a shear viscosity to entropy density ratio of eta/s = 0.095.

sources.title: The production of photons in relativistic heavy-ion collisions

claims.name: shear_viscosity_entropy_density_ratio___
claims.statement: The shear viscosity to entropy density ratio is $\eta/s = 1/4\pi$.

sources.title: Shear Viscosity from AdS Born-Infeld Black Holes

claims.name: shear_viscositytoentropydensity_ratio_takes_value
claims.statement: The shear viscosity-to-entropy-density ratio takes the value $\hbar/4\pi$.

sources.title: Black holes and non-relativistic quantum systems

claims.name: ratio_shear_viscosity_entropy_density_
claims.statement: The ratio of shear viscosity to entropy density is computed in this background.

sources.title: Analytic Approaches to anisotropic Holographic Superfluids

claims.name: ratio_shear_viscosity_entropy_obtained
claims.statement: The ratio of shear viscosity to entropy is obtained using the diffusion constant.

sources.title: The effect of higher derivative correction on $η/s$ and conductivities in STU model

claims.name: shear_viscosity_entropy_density_ratio____
claims.statement: The shear viscosity to entropy density ratio, $\frac{\eta }{s}$, is calculated holographically.

sources.title: Viscosity of $R^2$ Modified AdS Black Brane

claims.name: lloyd_bound_reduced_shear_viscosity
claims.statement: The Lloyd bound is reduced to the shear viscosity to entropy ratio (SVER).

claims.name: proposed_general_bound_concerns_ratio
claims.statement: The proposed general bound concerns the ratio of shear viscosity to entropy density.

sources.title: Response to D.T. Son's comment on ``Is there a `most perfect fluid' consistent with quantum field theory?''

claims.name: shear_viscosity_bound_violation_einstein
claims.statement: The shear viscosity bound violation in Einstein gravity for anisotropic black branes is analyzed with the aim of constraining the deviation of the shear viscosity-entropy density ratio from the shear viscosity bound.

sources.title: Notes on shear viscosity bound violation in anisotropic models

claims.name: ratio_shear_viscosity_entropy_density__
claims.statement: The ratio of the shear viscosity to entropy density violated the viscosity bound for the prolate black brane solution.

sources.title: Thermoelectric conductivities, shear viscosity, and stability in an anisotropic linear axion model
